quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions, the following rules apply: A vehicle must not travel more than 200 feet in a center turn lane before making a left-hand turn from the highway.

activation.description: A highway has one center lane designed only for turns by both directions.
activation.source_clause: a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions

obligation.description: Do not travel more than 200 feet in that lane before the left turn from the highway.
obligation.source_clause: must not travel more than 200 feet in a center turn lane before making a left-hand turn from the highway

timing.description: Measure from full-body entry to observed left-turn onset.
timing.source_clause: must not travel more than 200 feet in a center turn lane before making a left-hand turn from the highway
